name: Invisimon
main_effect:
[Security] [End of Opponent's Turn] Play this card without paying the cost.
[On Play] [When Digivolving] ＜De-Digivolve 2＞ 1 of your opponent's Digimon. (Trash up to 2 cards from the top. You can't trash past level 3 cards.) and flip your opponent's top face-down security card face up. Then, delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with 1 or fewer digivolution cards.
[Your Turn] When your Digimon checks a face-up security card, you may place the top card of this Digimon face-up at the bottom of your security stack.
